# Free Shipping Banner

`promotional/free-shipping` &middot; section-level &middot; category: promotional

## Purpose

A free-shipping message, optionally with a progress bar toward the threshold.

## Required fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `text` | text |  |

## Optional fields

| Field | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `remaining` | text |  |
| `progress` | number |  |

## Variants

Same data and structure, different styling. Pick one with `{ variant: 'name' }`.

- **default**: On the page background color, with a green progress bar.
- **accent**: White text on the accent color, white bar. Sets `background: @colors.accent`, `barColor: @colors.white`, `trackColor: @colors.secondary`.
- **dark**: White text on the primary color. Sets `background: @colors.primary`, `barColor: @colors.success`, `trackColor: @colors.secondary`.

## Settings

Every setting has a default. Values may be token references (`@colors.accent`, `@theme.card.radius`). Pass overrides with `{ settings: { ... } }`.

| Setting | Type | Default |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `hideOnMobile` | boolean | `false` |
| `hideOnDesktop` | boolean | `false` |
| `background` | color | `"@colors.background"` |
| `textColor` | text | `"@colors.white"` |
| `barColor` | color | `"@colors.success"` |
| `trackColor` | color | `"@colors.border"` |
| `barHeight` | length | `"8px"` |
| `radius` | length | `"@radius.pill"` |
| `gap` | length | `"@spacing.sm"` |
| `padding` | spacing | `"@spacing.md @theme.section.paddingX"` |

## Responsive behavior

- `hideOnMobile`: hides it below 480px. Outlook desktop and Gmail on non-Google accounts ignore media queries and still show it.
- `hideOnDesktop`: shows it only on phones. Clients that ignore media queries keep it hidden.

## Compatibility

| Outlook desktop | Gmail apps | Dark mode |
| --- | --- | --- |
| The bar is a two-cell table, honored. Rounded ends are square. | Fine. | On the brand surface the text swaps, on colored bands the colors stay. |



## Example usage

This is a section-level component: use it directly in an email body or a recipe.

In an email (`.mjml`):

```
[[ c('promotional/free-shipping', {
  "text": "You are $12.50 away from free shipping",
  "progress": 83,
  "remaining": "Spend $75 or more and we will ship it free."
}) ]]
```

As data (a node, for recipes and the remix API):

```json
{
  "component": "promotional/free-shipping",
  "data": {
    "text": "You are $12.50 away from free shipping",
    "progress": 83,
    "remaining": "Spend $75 or more and we will ship it free."
  }
}
```
